name: insufficient-credits
description: RE-VERIFIED LIVE 2026-11-04 (replaces the 2026-10-28 recording, which is now stale): a real agent key drained to a 0 balance, asked for 5 more funds. The vendor's insufficient-credits response shape changed between 2026-10-28 and today -- it used to be an ad-hoc JSON-RPC body ({error: {data: {error_reason: 'insufficient_credits', nothing_charged: true}}}); it is now a real MPP (micropayment protocol, https://mpp.dev) payment-required challenge: HTTP 402, Content-Type application/problem+json, a WWW-Authenticate: Payment ... header (omitted from this fixture -- the testing harness's replay mode only exercises status + body, same as every other fixture here), and an RFC 9457 problem-details body. Found while building search-lps/, which returns the identical shape for its own insufficient-credits case -- this appears to be a platform-wide change, not tool-specific. Still a real non-2xx either way, so provider.ts's lifecycle.start relays it untouched without caring about the difference; only this fixture and test needed updating, no code change.

body.title: Payment Required
body.hint: Use a supported wallet to pay for this resource using one of the supported payment methods returned in the WWW-Authenticate header. See https://mpp.dev/tools/wallet.md
